nne: NNE is the compass point that is midway between north and northeast.
NNE means the same as north northeast or nor'-nor'-east.
nnrti: NNRTI is an antiviral drug used against HIV.
NNRTI means the same as non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor.
nnw: NNW is the compass point that is midway between north and northwest.
NNW means the same as north northwest or nor'-nor'-west.
